<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Well, could I ask ya to give me a hand with somethin’
while you’re at it, kid?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m thinkin’ it might even help with that town-building
you’ve got goin’ on!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Well hey, I do appreciate it! Now, let’s get down to brass
tacks—<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>I need ya to bring me <$cdef(27)>six <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>.
Think ya can manage that?

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>I need ya to bring me <$cdef(27)>six <$ifull(118)>. Think ya
can manage that?

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>See, I need all that stuff to fix the <$cdef(27)>lifts.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>The islands of this town look like they all used to be
connected by <$cdef(27)>lifts. I figure we could use ’em to come ’n’
go as we please...<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>if they weren’t all broken down, that is.

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>So I was thinkin’, if the <$cdef(27)>lifts are all busted, the obvious
thing to do is fix ’em up! Make ’em usable again!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Turns out, though, I need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)> for that, ’n’ I got
no clue how to make any.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>I bet ol’ <$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr knows how to make it. If you find
<$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr kickin’ around somewhere, <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>couldja ask ’em
to whip up some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)> for me?

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Just so you know, I bet <$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr’s hanging out
somewhere like this.

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, I almost forgot! Ya need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1090)> to make
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>!
You should be able to find a bunch around here. <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Might
not be a bad idea to gather some before ya head out!

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Couldja get me <$cdef(27)>six <$ifull(118)> so I can fix the
<$cdef(27)>lifts around here?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr</color> should know how to make <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(118)></color>!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Ya need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1090)> to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>!
You should be able to find a bunch around here. <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Might
not be a bad idea to gather some before ya head out!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Hey, do I spy some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>? Thanks for bringin’ it
to me!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,4)>I hate to immediately hit you with another chore, but...I
actually need <$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>one more special part to get the <$cdef(27)>lifts in
workin’ order.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>How fortunate that you met another Pokémon who’s good
at building!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>And it certainly seems like those <$cdef(27)>lifts would come in handy
if they were fixed. I think you ought to help!

<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,6)>What’s that now? Ya want some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>? That’s a
mighty fine thing to be wantin’, young’un!
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>You’ve definitely come to the right Pokémon!

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>There’s jus’ one li’l problem... If ya wanna make some
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)>, we’re gonna need a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1458)>!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>It’s a machine ya put <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1090)> into—that material’s
key, mind you!—and then it mixes it all up fer ya!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Think ya could procure me one?
You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe </color>for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1458)></color>!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Well I’ll be! You’re a dependable young’un if ever I
saw one!
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Once you’ve made yerself a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1458)>, set it up
near the water. <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,666)>Lemme know when you’re done, ya hear?

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh! And don’t forget to have some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1090)>
ready too!

<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Set yer <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1458)> up next to the water! Like a
pond or a pool or somethin’! <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Then come lemme know
when you’re done, ya hear?

<$comeff(4,13)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Seems like you’ve got yerself a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1458)> all
ready to go!

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>Now all you’ve gotta do is put some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1090)> in the
mixer and take me over to it. <$comeff(4,10)><$voicel(4,7)>I’ll whip ya up some
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(118)> in no time flat!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I had a look, and I think we need a kinda special gear to
get these <$cdef(27)>lifts up and running. <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Problem is, I can’t find a
gear like that anywhere around here.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>So I figure I can just make one myself, y’know? <$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>But here’s
the catch: I need an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(115)>.

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Guess you know what I’m ’bout to ask, eh,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,7)>I’d be real grateful if you could go find me <$cdef(27)>one
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(115)>!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,8)>Wait, hold on... Hey, looks like you’ve already got an
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(115)> on you!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Think you could spare <$cdef(27)>one for me, kid?
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>Awesome—this is great! You can leave the rest to me!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>I just gotta “bop-bam-wham!” this into shape with my
hammer, and we’ll have a gear in no time!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Gimme a minute, all right?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>I need <$cdef(27)>one</color> <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(115)></color> to make that special gear!

<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>Hey, an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(115)>! You managed to bring me one, eh?
Much appreciated!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>I just gotta “bop-bam-wham!” this into shape with my
hammer, and we’ll have a gear in no time!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Gimme a minute, all right?

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Bop-bam-wham! Bop-bam-wham!
...Oh hey, kid. Sorry, this might take just a bit more.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>And a bop! And a bam! And a WHAM! There we go—
all done!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, hey there, <$cdef(27)>! Perfect timing.
<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,8)>Here, you can hang on to this!
You received some <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(119)></color>!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>With that, you’ll be able to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)>!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Just set up two <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)> a good distance from
each other, <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>and the <$cdef(27)>lift’ll start movin’ between ’em!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>C’mon, we got no time to waste! Let’s go set up the first
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)>! <$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Follow me!
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>This way, kid! Just follow me!
